parameters.name: sampleLimit
parameters.description: stop refining the frame after this number of samples

parameters.name: denoiseStart
parameters.description: accumulated sample count at which denoising starts; negative values count back from sampleLimit (-1 == only the final frame)

parameters.name: denoiseMode
parameters.description: mode controlling buffers given to the denoiser

parameters.name: fireflyFilterMode
parameters.description: removes bright speckle (firefly) noise: none (off), tonemap (aggressive; strongest suppression but can dim the image), clamp (moderate; caps only the brightest outlier samples), trim (gentlest; energy-preserving, discards only detected outliers)

parameters.name: fireflyFilterSigma
parameters.description: clamp/trim mode: outlier sensitivity; lower removes more aggressively

parameters.name: fireflyFilterWarmup
parameters.description: clamp mode: samples observed before filtering starts; higher delays filtering but estimates the cap more reliably

parameters.name: fireflyFilterTrim
parameters.description: trim mode: how many outlier samples to track per pixel; higher is more robust but uses more memory

parameters.name: premultiplyBackground
parameters.description: pre-multiply alpha channel with background color

parameters.name: checkerboarding
parameters.description: use checkerboarding to lower frame latency

parameters.name: maxTransparencyDepth
parameters.description: Maximum number of stochastic alpha-coverage pass-throughs before a path ends; separate from maxRayDepth so deep cutout stacks do not consume the bounce budget

parameters.name: cutPlane
parameters.description: cutting plane equation (nx, ny, nz, d); disabled when all zero (vec4(0))
